chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
My father, peace be upon him, used to hold the launderer and the goldsmith liable for what they damaged, while ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, peace be upon them both, would show favor toward them.

key_terms.الصَّوَّاغَ: the goldsmith or jeweler entrusted with valuables
key_terms.الْقَصَّارَ: the launderer or cloth-cleaner entrusted with garments
key_terms.مَا أَفْسَدَا: whatever the two damaged or ruined
key_terms.يُضَمِّنُ: to hold legally liable for compensation

ai.seo_question: Are a launderer or goldsmith liable if they damage property entrusted to them?
ai.summary: The Imam, peace be upon him, reports two approaches regarding hired workers who damage property entrusted to them. One approach imposed liability on the launderer and goldsmith for the damage they caused, while Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام acted with leniency toward them.
